kinetic_volatilization_note: An explicit escaped-metal state conserves the initial metal-atom budget. Total retention at each pulse matches the existing sourced-thermal empirical ICP retention prior, not a second independent loss penalty. A gas-atom formation-energy proxy weights the timing of loss along the waveform; absent escape descriptors use disclosed uniform-time allocation. Relative state susceptibility weights are elicited, not measured vapor pressures or supported-atom desorption barriers. Changing hold/profile changes loss timing and structural competition, but total retention still follows the frozen temperature/count prior; duration-dependent total ICP loss requires new data and retraining.
kinetic_note: Electrospinning supplies the user-assumed initially uniform dispersed precursor: D=1, captured S=0, clustered C=0. This is not evidence of pre-existing supported metallic single atoms. Carbonization-related site activation/capture competes with mobile self/unlike aggregation, detachment, site damage and cluster redispersion. Literature motivates the competing pathways, not these numerical rates, barriers, site capacities or XRD observation weights. All kinetic parameters are elicited; ICP/XRD alone do not identify them independently. No fixed high-temperature or below-1000 C penalty is used by the competitive path. The retained-metal decoder remains separate and unchanged.
reference_note: User-reported Fe aggregation onset at 2.4 mmol in 20 mL corresponds to 120 mM. Treating this as median 50% XRD failure at the reference condition is an elicited modeling choice, not a measured probability.
coefficient_note: All coefficient distributions, transferability to other elements, pulse direction, nanoscale mixing relevance and dose-threshold uncertainty are explicitly elicited assumptions; none are fitted to experimental XRD data.
pulse_profile_note: Latest user observation: approximately 1 s to 3000 K. This supersedes 10000 C/s as the average ramp rate: from an assumed 25 C baseline it implies 2701.85 C/s. Cooling range 1000-1400 C/s and peak hold about 100 ms are user-reported approximations. A linear ramp extrapolated to other peaks, a 25 C baseline and full cooldown before subsequent pulses are assumptions; no measured temperature-time trace has been supplied.
migration_note: Element barriers use Fe-centered log bulk-thermal descriptors with elicited slopes, element residuals and relative-prefactor uncertainty. These are not tabulated support-specific diffusivities or DFT results. Missing descriptors remain missing and add an explicit zero-centered discrepancy. Self/unlike-pair exposure uses both diffusivities and actual molar fractions. Pair chemistry enters through the separate mixing term, not as a fabricated diffusion barrier. The competitive process uses instantaneous mobility inside its state equations; the cumulative encounter score is applied only in the legacy process path. Encounter tables remain diagnostics. No absolute distance is inferred.
interval_note: Quantiles describe sensitivity to elicited parameters conditional on fixed physical priors. They are not experimentally calibrated confidence or prediction intervals. Missing support/defect, precursor, crystallite-size and instrument effects remain unresolved.
